name: Mesuniku no Oshie ~Injoku no Jusei Seibo~
original_name: 牝肉の教え〜淫辱の受精聖母〜
source:
St Mary's Church holds many big breasted sisters. Some of them crave for uncontrollable pleasures. And today wishes come true.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圣玛丽教堂里有很多大胸姐妹。他们中的一些人渴望无法控制的快乐。今天愿望成真。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
